notifications.title: Allow physical-geography map Shorts on Naksha Bharat?
notifications.detail: Geo Study (858K subscribers) has two Shorts above 1M this autumn on a range or a project drawn on the map (Aravalli splitting Rajasthan, 1.67M; Kalpasar dam in the Gulf of Khambhat, 1.1M). The channel's profile covers states, formation, India vs the world and state vs country only, so research can't add this as a format without you.
notifications.fix: 1. If you want it, add a line under 'What it covers' in channels/india-maps/profile.md, e.g. 'a mountain range, river or big project drawn across the map, from official sources'. 2. Leave a channel note on the dashboard; research then writes the format and topics and the improver builds the kit piece (proposal im-format-nature-on-map). 3. If not, ignore this: it drops off next run once you leave a 'no' note.
